sticker.title: Print QR stickers
sticker.hint: Deselect objects, pick the sheet format and print. Every sticker carries the QR code, the object name, the object number and the 112 notice.

sticker.empty: No object selected — nothing will be printed.

sticker.emergencyNotice: For fire or danger: emergency call 112. This form is never an emergency call.
